description: 5K-CENDERE olarak bilim ve teknolojiyi sürdürülebilir tarımla buluşturmayı hedefleyen bir ekibiz. NASA'nın Dünya gözlem verilerinden yararlanarak iklim değişikliğine uyum sağlayan, toprak sağlığını koruyan ve su kaynaklarının verimli kullanılmasını destekleyen akıllı bir karar destek sistemi geliştirmeyi amaçlıyoruz. Yazılım, yapay zekâ, veri analizi ve tarım teknolojilerini bir araya getirerek gerçek sorunlara yenilikçi çözümler üretmek için çalışıyoruz.
summary:
ANADOLU – From Space Data to Smarter Agriculture

Agriculture is increasingly threatened by climate change, water scarcity, rising temperatures, and unpredictable environmental conditions. ANADOLU is a satellite-based agricultural monitoring and decision-support platform that transforms NASA Earth observation data into accessible and meaningful information for sustainable farming.

By analyzing environmental indicators such as land surface temperature, vegetation health, precipitation, and soil-related conditions, ANADOLU helps users understand changing agricultural environments, monitor potential risks, and evaluate conditions that may affect crop development. Through an interactive digital interface, complex satellite observations are translated into visual insights that support more informed agricultural decisions.

What makes ANADOLU valuable is its approach to connecting space technology with real-world agricultural needs. Rather than presenting satellite data as isolated scientific measurements, it aims to make Earth observation resources understandable and useful for agricultural communities.

Our vision is to contribute to climate-resilient agriculture, more responsible water and resource management, and long-term food security. ANADOLU demonstrates how observing Earth from space can help us protect the land that sustains life on it.
details:
ANADOLU – From Space Data to Smarter Agriculture

ANADOLU is a satellite-based agricultural monitoring and decision-support platform designed to address the growing challenges of climate change, water scarcity, and environmental uncertainty in agriculture. Our project aims to transform NASA Earth observation data into accessible, meaningful, and practical information that can support more informed agricultural decisions.

How Does It Work?

ANADOLU uses Earth observation datasets to examine environmental conditions that influence agricultural areas. By analyzing indicators such as land surface temperature, vegetation health, precipitation, and relevant soil-related parameters, the platform aims to help users understand environmental changes and identify conditions that may negatively affect agricultural productivity.

The collected information is processed and presented through a web-based interface. Interactive visualizations, maps, graphs, and comparative data displays make complex satellite observations easier to understand. Users can examine environmental conditions, monitor changes over time, and evaluate potential agricultural risks.

Benefits and Intended Impact

Our project aims to make satellite-based environmental information more accessible to agricultural communities, researchers, and decision-makers. It supports climate-aware agricultural planning, encourages responsible water management, and promotes sustainable use of natural resources. By improving access to environmental information, ANADOLU seeks to contribute to climate-resilient agriculture and long-term food security.

Technology and Development

We developed the platform using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to create its web interface, interactive components, and data visualization structure. NASA Earth observation resources provide the scientific foundation of the project. Digital mapping and visualization techniques are used to present environmental information in an understandable format. Our development approach focuses on combining scientific data with an accessible and functional digital experience.

Creativity and Innovation

The innovative aspect of ANADOLU is its approach to connecting space science with agricultural needs. Satellite observations are not simply displayed as technical measurements; our goal is to transform them into understandable insights that can support real-world agricultural awareness and decision-making.

Factors Considered by Our Team

During development, we considered data reliability, accessibility, usability, environmental sustainability, climate variability, water scarcity, and the different needs of agricultural users. We also focused on creating an interface that can be understood by people without advanced technical knowledge.

Our vision is to demonstrate that space technology is not limited to exploring the universe. It can also help us understand, protect, and sustain life on Earth. With ANADOLU, we aim to turn the power of observing Earth from space into a meaningful contribution to the future of agriculture.
